integrity: The proof uses exact exponential-normalization and Bernoulli transfer-matrix identities. Reproducibility checks are supplied. Historical priority and mathematical correctness have not undergone independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact first positive sample size and uniqueness of the sign change are not established. The claim is restricted to uniform cyclic spacings; the asymptotic result rests on analytic estimates, not numerical quadrature.
title: A sign reversal and a sharp residual covariance for two extreme circular spacings
